items.exampleEn: The monkey is eating a banana.
A butterfly is flying in the garden.
The frog can jump very high.
The tiger is a big cat.
items.exampleZh: 老虎是一種大型貓科動物。

items.exampleEn: She has white lilies in her garden.
items.exampleZh: 她的花園裡種了白色的百合花。

items.exampleEn: It is foggy this morning, so I can't see the mountain.
items.exampleZh: 今天早上起霧，所以我看不到山。

items.exampleEn: He gives her a red rose.

items.sentenceEn: The monkey is in the tree.

items.audioEn: It is foggy today, so the boats will not go out.
items.audioZh: 今天起霧，所以船不會出海。

items.sentenceEn: Roses and lilies are beautiful flowers.
items.sentenceZh: 玫瑰和百合是很美的花。

items.sentenceEn: Look! A butterfly is on the rose.
items.sentenceZh: 看！有一隻蝴蝶停在玫瑰上。

items.stemEn: A ____ likes to eat bananas and lives in trees.
items.stemZh: 猴子喜歡吃香蕉，住在樹上。

items.stemEn: It is very ____. I can't see the other side of the street.
items.stemZh: 霧很大，我看不到街道的另一邊。

items.passageEn: My grandmother has a beautiful garden. There are red roses and white lilies. In the morning, it is often foggy. When the sun comes out, butterflies fly over the flowers. A small frog lives by the water bucket. Its name is Momo!
items.passageZh: 我奶奶有一座美麗的花園，裡面有紅玫瑰和白百合。早上常常起霧。太陽出來後，蝴蝶就在花上飛來飛去。有一隻小青蛙住在水桶旁邊，牠的名字叫 Momo！

questions.questionZh: 奶奶的花園裡有什麼花？

referenceEn: The tiger is a very strong animal.
rubricZh: 泛指一種動物可用 The tiger is…、Tigers are…、A tiger is… 等
形容詞 strong 放在名詞 animal 前面；寫 Tigers are very strong. 也正確

items.instructionZh: 用 rose 造一個句子，說說你喜歡的花或送花的經驗。
referenceEn: I gave my mother a rose on her birthday.
rubricZh: 送花可用 give someone a rose 或 give a rose to someone（過去式 gave）
